evals.prompt: Verify the checklist on PR #96 before I merge. It was written with dual-track-pr-creator.
evals.expected_output: Resolves PR #96 with `command gh` and records headRefOid. Parses the `## Verification` checklist and classifies each unchecked item. CI is checked with `gh pr checks <n> --json name,state,bucket --required` and bound to the head with the check-runs for headRefOid; it is ticked only if every required check passed on that commit. The evidence section is placed between the checklist and `## Not included / out of scope` with --before-heading, not at the top of the body, and --audit-table is used. Reports ticked vs left-unchecked with reasons and names the head SHA verified.

evals.prompt: The PR has an item saying 'screen reader announces the active nav segment'. Our e2e test asserts aria-current="page" is present and it passes. Check it off.
evals.expected_output: Applies the evidence-kind gate and declines to tick. Explains that the e2e assertion proves the attribute exists, not that a screen reader announces it, so the item as written is not satisfied. Classified BLOCKED, needs a human (assistive technology). Records the attribute evidence in the evidence section while leaving the box unchecked. Does not tick on the strength of adjacent evidence.

evals.prompt: One checklist item is 'tag gate works on the new main' — can you confirm it so we can merge?
evals.expected_output: Recognises that proving it requires pushing a release tag, which deploys to production, and refuses to manufacture the event to close a box. Classified BLOCKED, deferred, naming the event that unblocks it (the first tag after merge). Left unchecked and reported as such.

evals.prompt: CI is green on the PR now — update the description. The item currently reads 'CI on this PR — not yet observed at the time of writing'.
evals.expected_output: Does not take 'CI is green' on trust: reads headRefOid, runs `gh pr checks --required`, and confirms the checks ran on that commit. If checks for the current head are pending (exit 8) or the head moved after the green run, leaves the item unchecked as BLOCKED, deferred. On PASS, uses --reword with text that appears in only that one unchecked item, in the same pass as the flip, so the ticked line no longer says 'not yet observed'. Diffs, re-reads headRefOid right before `gh pr edit --body-file`, and pushes only if it is unchanged.

evals.prompt: Check off the test plan on my current branch's PR. Don't check anything you can't actually prove.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the branch's PR and confirms local HEAD equals headRefOid with a clean working tree before trusting local test or build runs; if they differ, asks before switching rather than ticking from the wrong tree. Detects whether the body is a generic test plan or a dual-track body and places the evidence section accordingly. Ticks only PASSes with evidence, surfaces any FAIL as a finding, and separates BLOCKED items into needs-a-human versus deferred-to-an-event. On a dual-track body, also reconciles the traceability table and `## Not included / out of scope`.

evals.prompt: I just ran the QA on PR #19 and the mobile tab-strip scroll + the reload persistence both pass. Can you verify them properly and get the PR description up to date?
evals.expected_output: Treats the user's results as a lead, not evidence. Re-runs both browser checks through webapp-testing against a build of the PR's current head, and ticks only what it re-ran and saw pass; if the checks cannot be run, both stay unchecked and the user's report is recorded as unconfirmed. Uses each item's full text as --check, adds a `## QA Verification` section right after the generic `## Test plan` (no --before-heading needed), and leaves subjective items such as PM sign-off unchecked.

evals.prompt: Can you confirm the checklist items on PR #42 actually work? One of them is 'category filter returns 200 for each tab' and one is 'PM approved the copy'.
evals.expected_output: Resolves PR #42 and pins headRefOid. Verifies the API item with curl against a service built from the head, ticking it only if every tab returns 200; a FAIL is surfaced as a finding rather than skipped or retried until it passes. 'PM approved the copy' is BLOCKED, needs a human, and stays unchecked. The PR body changes only for the verified item.

evals.prompt: PR #12's test plan has 'Deploy api to staging and smoke test' and 'Deploy web to staging and smoke test'. I only got the api one done. Tick that one and leave the web one.
evals.expected_output: Re-runs the api smoke test against staging built from the head before ticking. Passes the api item's full text as --check, never a shared fragment like 'Deploy' or 'to staging', because a fragment found in several items ticks none and --strict exits 2. Leaves the web item unchecked and reports it as not yet verified.
